core_obligations: Preserve all Boolean relation/polymorphism and clone hypotheses for the two dichotomies.
Retain full author monotone reduction and satisfiability algorithms, exact lower-bound premises and classifications.

difficulty_reason: The authors translate primitive-positive definability into monotone reductions and classify Boolean CSPs through polymorphism clones in Post lattice. Explicit monotone satisfiability algorithms cover the tractable clones, while XOR/Horn reductions give exponential monotone size or polynomial monotone depth lower bounds. Both classifications form one independent main contribution.

dedup.scope: Root zero same DOI neighbors. Monotone size and depth/formula classifications grouped once as the main Boolean CSP dichotomy contribution. Clone-by-clone algorithms, monotone reductions, XOR support, Schaefer support and direct limit consequences are uncounted context.
